'''Black_wraith Trying to Rescue the Princess''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 2 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif|label=Rescue The Princess}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 RTP Black wraith LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Cell 2187 (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Commander Vanden Willard (V), Civil Disorder (V), Flash Of Insight (V), Keep Your Eyes Open (V), Bionic Hand (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

As the name implies, I’m trying to build a rescue the princess deck, but don’t know which way to go, am I close?

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59: Prisoner 2187 (unique) is listed under both Starting and Characters; counted once. The headers (60) count it twice.
* Posted 'Flash (c) X2' dested Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5), reading '(c)' as a typo for '(v)' (the author lists 'Flash (v) X2' in his other decks); the printed Dagobah Flash Of Insight is the alternative.
* Original-era (V): Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1); Cell 2187 (V) and Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Set 3); Flash Of Insight (V) x2 (Virtual Set 5); Civil Disorder (V), Keep Your Eyes Open (V) x3 and Bionic Hand (V) (Virtual Set 6). The draft had dropped the (V) on Keep Your Eyes Open.
* Posted '“ Docking bay' (ditto of Yavin 4) dested Yavin 4: Docking Bay; 'D* Docking bay' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'D* Detention block' Death Star: Detention Block Corridor; 'Maj. Olander britt' Major Olander Brit; 'Artoo' the Jabba's Palace Artoo; 'Briky morning' Brisky Morning Munchen.

== Strategy ==

As I said be for, this is my first attempt at this deck. Not too much strategy thought up, the little there is you could probably figure it out you selves. Vanden Willard boosts leias defence, Kessel drains well, know gift and protector add destinies, sabers add to drains. That’s all I really got, so help me out, please.

thanks sithborg. a newer version of this deck is sure to come later either next week, or shortly there after.
